scenes.text: The oldest shark-like scales are around four hundred and fifty million years old.
The first true trees only appeared about three hundred and eighty-five million years ago.
So for tens of millions of years, sharks swam in oceans next to land with no forests at all.
They also survived all five mass extinctions, including the one that wiped out the dinosaurs.
What animal do you think is the most ancient?

title: Sharks are OLDER than trees 🦈
caption: The earliest shark scales date back ~450 million years, while the first trees appeared ~385 million years ago. Sharks have survived all five mass extinctions. 🦈
